headline: Iran responds to the US memorandum and dictates the conditions to Trump who threatens: "Unacceptable, we will take the uranium"
summary: Iran presented its response to a US memorandum on a Middle East ceasefire, demanding an immediate cessation of hostilities. Trump called the conditions unacceptable and threatened to take the uranium.
why: Ceasefire and nuclear negotiations between Washington and Tehran shape oil supply risk and regional stability, both of which feed into global markets.
why_moved: A rejected ceasefire response and a threat over Iran's uranium raise the prospect of prolonged conflict in a key oil-producing region.
